entry_gate_interpretation.new_signal_eligibility: Only fully post-freeze completed M15 bars may establish a new qualification or trigger. A bar opening before the actual freeze is contextual only. No confirmation timestamp may precede valid_from.
entry_gate_interpretation.M15_qualification: For SELL, a completed rejection in/through the active resistance zone closing below its lower edge; BUY mirrors above support. Directional indicator improvement must corroborate. A price/EMA state alone is not a new trigger.
entry_gate_interpretation.M15_trigger: A subsequent completed directional close beyond the qualification candle low for SELL or high for BUY. Must remain valid at the cutoff.
entry_gate_interpretation.M30_confirmation: Completed directional acceptance beyond the active-zone exit boundary and local structure, with close on directional side of EMA10/EMA20 and corroborating momentum. Mere touch is insufficient.
entry_gate_interpretation.H1_permission: Completed close on directional side of EMA10/EMA20 and active structural boundary, with regime-consistent MACD direction or explicitly demonstrated momentum turn. Positive but declining histogram alone is not equivalent to fully bearish permission.
entry_gate_interpretation.H4_allowance: Completed H4 regime permits direction and specified scenario invalidation has not occurred. Countertrend trades require an explicit H4 turn; support touch alone is insufficient.
entry_gate_interpretation.first_full_confirmation: Earliest eligible close_time when all specified gates coexist. No earlier historical confirmation under this newly frozen map.
entry_gate_interpretation.opposing_level_selection: Use the near edge of the nearest unconsumed opposing zone; do not skip an intervening zone to enlarge remaining room.
entry_gate_interpretation.no_chase: Consumption strictly below 65%; remaining room at least 2.5 M15 ATR at exact full confirmation; recheck fresh-entry location at requested cutoff.
